concept.title: Cybersecurity @ NC State
concept.shortdesc: Learn strategies to keep you and the rest of NC State's campus secure.

conbody.p: At NC State, cybersecurity is a team effort. Well-informed university community members are the most effective weapons against cybersecurity threats. Members who understand and accept their roles and responsibilities to protect digital assets are more vigilant against those threats and more likely to take appropriate steps to thwart them. This website will be split into five modules explaining how to keep you and the Pack safe.

ul.li: Protecting your account (Unity ID, Multi-Factor Authentication, and strong passwords)
